city_status.summary_en: Air quality in Belgrade is moderate; sensitive individuals may experience slight effects.

superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Odbacujem Observerov skok od svežeg prijema do prostornih uslova: broj instrumenata i vrednosti ne otkriva mi ni očitavanja ni njihov raspored. Connectorova veza među vestima o vodi i dalje nema zajedničku lokaciju i vreme događaja; Tanjugov naslov ne potvrđuje prekid koji se dešava sada. [F3][F6]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I reject Observer’s leap from fresh reception to spatial conditions: instrument and value counts tell me neither the readings nor their distribution [F3]. Connector’s water thread still lacks a shared event location and time; Tanjug’s headline does not establish an interruption happening now [F6].
